import { useState } from 'react' import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import { LogOut, Bell, Search, Menu, ChevronDown, User, Settings as SettingsIcon, HelpCircle, Sun, Moon, Grid, Filter } from 'lucide-react' const Header = ({ user, onMenuClick, onSearch, currentPage }) => { const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('') const [showUserMenu, setShowUserMenu] = useState(false) const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState(false) const navigate = useNavigate() const handleLogout = () => { localStorage.removeItem('token') localStorage.removeItem('user') navigate('/') } const handleSearch = (e) => { const query = e.target.value setSearchQuery(query) onSearch(query) } const getPageTitle = (page) => { const titles = { overview: 'Vue d\'ensemble', projects: 'Gestion des Projets', tasks: 'Mes Tâches', calendar: 'Calendrier', messages: 'Messagerie', documents: 'Documents', billing: 'Facturation', security: 'Sécurité', settings: 'Paramètres' } return titles[page] || 'Dashboard' } const getPageIcon = (page) => { const icons = { overview: '📊', projects: '📁', tasks: '✅', calendar: '📅', messages: '💬', documents: '📄', billing: '💰', security: '🔒', settings: '⚙️' } return icons[page] || '🏠' } return (
{/* Page Title & Breadcrumb */}
{getPageIcon(currentPage)}

{getPageTitle(currentPage)}

Dashboard {getPageTitle(currentPage)}
{/* Search Bar */}
{/* Quick Actions */}
{/* Notifications */} {/* User Menu */}
{/* Dropdown User Menu */} {showUserMenu && ( <>
setShowUserMenu(false)} >

{user?.first_name} {user?.last_name}

{user?.email}

)}
{/* Mobile Search */}
) } export default Header
